messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error in INLA::f(region, verbose = TRUE, model = "iid", hyper = list(theta = list(prior = "logtgaussian", : Argument `verbose' in formula specification
parts:
Hi,
the problem is you misunderstood the correction about where the
verbose=TRUE parameter belongs.
Instead of moving it from the f() in your formula to the inla() call,
you changed the f() in the formula to inla().

Solution:
1. Remove verbose=TRUE from anywhere in your formula
2. Change your "+inla(region, ...)" code in the formula to "+f(region, ...)"
3. Add verbose=TRUE to the end of your parameter list for the "result
<- inla(...)" call.

Finn

> formula <- observados ~ f(region.struct,model="besag",graph="C:matriz.inla",
>
> hyper=list(theta=list(prior="logtgaussian",param=c(0,0.0001))))+inla(region,
> verbose = TRUE,model="iid",
>
> hyper=list(theta=list(prior="logtgaussian",param=c(0,0.0001))))
> +P.q2+P.q3+P.q4+P.q5
>
>
> result
> <-inla(formula2,family="poisson",data=RESP,E=expected,control.compute=list(dic=T,cpo=TRUE),
> control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,cdf=c(log(1))))
